changelog.en: The store now checks whether it is enabled for your Power PDF license. If it is not, the store button no longer appears in Power PDF. Your installed add-ons keep working.
changelog.de: Der Store prüft jetzt, ob er für Ihre Power-PDF-Lizenz freigegeben ist. Ist er es nicht, erscheint der Store-Knopf nicht mehr in Power PDF. Ihre installierten Add-ons funktionieren weiter.
changelog.fr: Le store vérifie désormais s'il est activé pour votre licence Power PDF. Si ce n'est pas le cas, le bouton du store n'apparaît plus dans Power PDF. Vos modules installés continuent de fonctionner.
changelog.it: Lo store ora verifica se è abilitato per la tua licenza di Power PDF. In caso contrario, il pulsante dello store non compare più in Power PDF. I componenti aggiuntivi installati continuano a funzionare.
changelog.es: La tienda comprueba ahora si está habilitada para su licencia de Power PDF. Si no lo está, el botón de la tienda deja de aparecer en Power PDF. Sus complementos instalados siguen funcionando.
changelog.nl: De store controleert nu of hij is vrijgegeven voor uw Power PDF-licentie. Is dat niet zo, dan verschijnt de storeknop niet meer in Power PDF. Uw geïnstalleerde add-ons blijven werken.
changelog.pt: A loja agora verifica se está habilitada para a sua licença do Power PDF. Se não estiver, o botão da loja não aparece mais no Power PDF. Seus suplementos instalados continuam funcionando.
changelog.da: Butikken kontrollerer nu, om den er frigivet til din Power PDF-licens. Hvis ikke, vises butiksknappen ikke længere i Power PDF. Dine installerede tilføjelser virker fortsat.
changelog.fi: Kauppa tarkistaa nyt, onko se käytössä Power PDF -lisenssillesi. Jos ei ole, kauppapainike ei enää näy Power PDF:ssä. Asennetut lisäosasi toimivat edelleen.
changelog.nb: Butikken sjekker nå om den er frigitt for Power PDF-lisensen din. Hvis ikke, vises ikke butikkknappen lenger i Power PDF. De installerte tilleggene dine fortsetter å virke.
changelog.sv: Butiken kontrollerar nu om den är aktiverad för din Power PDF-licens. Om inte visas butiksknappen inte längre i Power PDF. Dina installerade tillägg fortsätter att fungera.
changelog.pl: Sklep sprawdza teraz, czy jest włączony dla Twojej licencji Power PDF. Jeśli nie, przycisk sklepu nie pojawia się już w Power PDF. Zainstalowane dodatki nadal działają.
changelog.cs: Obchod nyní kontroluje, zda je povolen pro vaši licenci Power PDF. Pokud ne, tlačítko obchodu se v Power PDF již nezobrazí. Vaše nainstalované doplňky fungují dál.
changelog.hu: Az áruház most ellenőrzi, hogy engedélyezve van-e az Ön Power PDF-licencéhez. Ha nem, az áruház gombja már nem jelenik meg a Power PDF-ben. A telepített bővítmények tovább működnek.
changelog.ru: Магазин теперь проверяет, разрешен ли он для вашей лицензии Power PDF. Если нет, кнопка магазина больше не появляется в Power PDF. Установленные надстройки продолжают работать.
changelog.tr: Mağaza artık Power PDF lisansınız için etkin olup olmadığını denetliyor. Etkin değilse mağaza düğmesi artık Power PDF'de görünmez. Yüklü eklentileriniz çalışmaya devam eder.
changelog.zh-Hans: 商店现在会检查是否已为您的 Power PDF 许可启用。如果未启用，Power PDF 中将不再显示商店按钮。已安装的加载项继续正常工作。
changelog.zh-Hant: 商店現在會檢查是否已為您的 Power PDF 授權啟用。若未啟用，Power PDF 中將不再顯示商店按鈕。已安裝的增益集會繼續正常運作。
changelog.ja: ストアは、お使いの Power PDF ライセンスで利用が許可されているかを確認するようになりました。許可されていない場合、Power PDF にストアのボタンは表示されません。インストール済みのアドオンはそのまま動作します。
changelog.ko: 이제 스토어가 Power PDF 라이선스에 대해 사용이 허용되었는지 확인합니다. 허용되지 않으면 Power PDF에 스토어 단추가 더 이상 표시되지 않습니다. 설치된 추가 기능은 계속 작동합니다.
changelog.ar: يتحقق المتجر الآن مما إذا كان مفعّلاً لترخيص Power PDF الخاص بك. إذا لم يكن مفعّلاً، فلن يظهر زر المتجر في Power PDF بعد الآن. تستمر الإضافات المثبتة لديك في العمل.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.
